limitations: Weapons have not been aligned to player hands or holster poses.

Baked material atlas consolidates material slots; authoring source preserves separate metal, coating and polymer materials.
No cloth simulation, projectile, damage or ammunition logic.
metadata.mechanism_axes: Keyed translations converted from weapon-local world vectors into each bone local frame: slide/bolt +Y, magazine primarily -Z.
metadata.timing_status: Mechanical cue times only; no player-hand contacts or combat windows validated.
